category_edits.rationale: Reduce context to max(2, floor(0.75 * L)) across all four datasets to reduce distant-history noise and attention cost. Training and validation use MAXLEN; checkpoint metadata passes the same length to the generated predictor. Preserve chronological order, recency-aligned positions, and all other model and training settings.

change_summary: Shorten the default context from 128 to 96 interactions, consistently across training, validation, model construction, and generated inference.
